data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash
#
# Translated PBS script to Slurm
#

#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --time=48:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=10G # PBS vmem (virtual memory) was translated to SLURM's --mem (real memory), which is the closest equivalent.
#SBATCH --output=train_VOC%a.log
#SBATCH --error=train_VOC%a.err

# Change to the directory the job was submitted from
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"

# Execute the matlab command, replacing the PBS array variable with the Slurm equivalent
matlab -singleCompThread -nojvm -nosplash -nodesktop -r "train_VOC(${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}); quit;"

reasons: The script uses job array placeholders (%a) in the '--output' and '--error' directives but is missing the required '#SBATCH --array' directive to define the job array.
issues: The environment variable ${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID} is used in the matlab command but will be undefined unless the job is submitted with the '--array' option. This will likely cause the command to fail.
